notes.text: A bill can now be split By income, and the incomes you type are shared with the group's members.
Each of Home's Latest expenses now has a menu: Edit, Duplicate, Share and Delete.
See all on Home now opens All expenses: every bill you're part of, across your groups, with search, filters and sorting.
A group's photo is now bigger at the top of its screen and shrinks as you scroll, and opening a group animates from its row.
Activity now shows people's photos, Balances › By group shows each group's photo, and Statistics' Biggest expense shows its category.
Profile › Account and sync now shows the Google or Apple logo and your whole email, which only you see.
Delete account now explains what stays in your groups after your account is gone.
The Default Pix key switch no longer looks off on your default key in the dark theme.
